orgSetup.title: Set up your organization
orgSetup.description: Create your organization to manage sites and devices.

siteSetup.title: Add your first site
siteSetup.description: A site represents a physical location with devices.

deviceClaim.title: Claim your devices
deviceClaim.description: Add devices by entering their serial number and MAC address.

config.title: Configure Wi-Fi
config.description: Set up the wireless profile for your devices.
config.standardInfo: Standard mode applies WPA2 Personal security with auto band steering, QoS traffic prioritization, and no VLAN tagging.

activation.title: Activate your devices
activation.description: Connect your devices to power and wait for them to come online.
activation.step1: Connect an Ethernet cable from the PoE switch to the access point.
activation.step2: Plug the PoE switch into a power outlet.
activation.step3: Wait for the LED on the access point to turn solid green.
activation.timeout: We couldn't detect your device yet. It may take a few more minutes. You can continue and check the dashboard later.

success.title: You're all set!
success.description: Your network is configured and ready to go.
success.info: Your devices may take up to 5 minutes to appear in the dashboard.
